title: Duplicate Coin Pickup Attempt Due to Missing Collision Disabling
explanation: At frame 940, Coin5 triggered duplicate_pickup_attempt anomaly when the player re-entered its collision area during its picked animation. Traced to Coin.gd:L19-L35 (_on_body_entered) where picked() does not disable CollisionShape2D or disconnect body_entered, violating uniqueness and idempotent collectible pickup invariants.
